question: PC Thulasi, who was awarded with the GV Raja award by the Kerala government in January 2020, is a professional player of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**badminton**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **PC Thulasi**:

 
 
• Her full name is **Puthenpurayil Chandrika Thulasi.**
 
• She is an **Indian badminton player**.
 
• She was part of the **national team **that won the **gold medals in 2010 and 2016 South Asian Games**, also the **women's doubles silver in 2010**.
 
• She was the **women's singles national champion in 2016**, and the **gold medalist in 34th National Games**.
 
• She was **awarded with the GV Raja award **by the **Kerala government in January 2020**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jimmy George**, who played **volleyball for India's men's national team **from **8 March 1955 to 30 November 1987**, was regarded as one of the **sport's all-time greats**.
 
• The **superstar of Indian table tennis **is **Manika Batra**.
 
• **Satnam Singh **is the **best basketball player **in India.
